name: Apples and Bananas Quad-Infused Jeeter Joint | 1g
description: Apples and Bananas is an evenly balanced and delicious hybrid strain. When it comes to the flavor of this bud, the name says it all. Apples and Bananas packs a sweet and fruity taste that's filled with delicious sugary bananas and sharply sour apples, with a touch of black pepper to it. The aroma takes a spicier turn, with a sharp punch of savory diesel. The Apples and Bananas high is just as delicious, with full-bodied sensations that hit hard and leave you dazed. You'll feel the heady tingling almost immediately, lifting your mind into a state of happy euphoria accompanied by a boost of creativity.
